title: Concept: Package flagged for reinstallation
description: packages.config declares a `requireReinstallation` flag that marks drifted restore state, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `requireReinstallation` flag that marks drifted restore state.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.config (nuget).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `requireReinstallation` flag that marks drifted restore state.
